verdict.rationale: Cognee is open source and can be run fully locally/self-hosted (own Docker instance, local UI, no account required), which implicitly keeps user data off any third-party training pipeline. However, there is no explicit privacy policy, opt-out clause, or statement addressing whether Cognee Cloud or any hosted service uses customer data for model training. Missing for 10: explicit data-usage/training policy statement, terms-of-service language on model training, and any independent confirmation of this guarantee.
